events.title: The free demo is out now!
events.summary: The demo of Arcane Abyss is now available on Steam. Hit "Download Demo" on the store page and play it for free. Arcane Abyss is a turn-based roguelite where you throw weapons. Toss the weapons in your hand at monsters, knock the ones left on the board into each other to trigger Resonance, transfer abilities through synthesis, and build from scratch on every run.
